title: Protocols of the Elders of Zion as a Russian secret police hoax
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Protocols of the Elders of Zion as a Russian secret police hoax, about Tsarist era, before the Soviet Union at Russia, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We know it was a hoax invented by the secret police in Russia during the time of thesar even before the Soviet Union.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the Protocols of the Elders of Zion, a document claiming to reveal a Jewish plan to rule the world. He says it is known to be a hoax invented by the Russian secret police back in the days of the tsars, before the Soviet Union. He brings it up as an example of how a state can fake a document to shape what people believe.
